# AI 动态每日简报

> 生成日期：**2026-10-03** ｜ 来源：The Verge AI、TechCrunch AI（标题/摘要已译为中文，链接指向英文原文）

> 每日 09:00 自动抓取全球 AI 领域最新动态，整理为简报。


## 产品/应用（1 条）

- **Apple will limit Mac disk access as AI agents ‘substantially’ increase risk**  
  Apple will add new limits for "full disk access" on Mac in response to risks posed by AI a…  
  🔗 https://www.theverge.com/tech/1004295/apple-limit-mac-disk-access-ai-agents


## 其他（5 条）

- **Capcom is preparing for a ‘future where we create games together with AI’**  
  Capcom's Pragmata might be all about the horrors of AI, but in practice the studio doesn't…  
  🔗 https://www.theverge.com/games/1004418/capcom-ai-game-development

- **Splice CEO Kakul Srivastava thinks AI emails are killing conversations**  
  Kakul Srivastava is the CEO of Splice, the sample platform countless producers rely on for…  
  🔗 https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/1004162/splice-ceo-kakul-srivastava-ai-interview

- **An OpenAI safety employee has quit and is sounding the alarm**  
  David Robinson used to write the safety reports that accompanied every major model release…  
  🔗 https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1004408/openai-safety-quits-sounding-the-alarm

- **Meta open sources code to let you make Muse AI gadgets**  
  Meta now lets you make your own Muse gadgets that feature the company's new AI agent with …  
  🔗 https://www.theverge.com/tech/1004330/meta-muse-ai-gadgets-home-link

- **OpenAI’s Dot agent is enterprise software that can also order your dinner**  
  It's a tale as old as last week: OpenAI's new agent platform, called Dots, is full of cute…  
  🔗 https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1004096/openai-chatgpt-dots-hands-on-agent
